github_full_clones.retention_note: GitHub exposes only the latest 14 days and counts full clones, not fetches.

excluded.pypi_known_mirror_downloads: Excluded from the headline because automated mirror syncs are not end-user package retrievals.
excluded.github_source_archives: GitHub does not expose a separate source zip or tar archive download count.
excluded.mcp_registry: Discovery metadata only; its PyPI and npm package fetches are already counted above.
excluded.sdk_downloads: SDK code ships inside the counted Python, native-core, JavaScript and MCP packages; no second SDK total is added.
excluded.python_and_node_cli_proxy: The CLI and proxy are commands inside the counted entroly, entroly-core and entroly-mcp distributions; command usage is not a second download.
excluded.rust_proxy: Prebuilt entroly-rs archives are included in github_release_binaries; source builds begin with a GitHub clone already represented by clone traffic.
excluded.homebrew: The formula installs the PyPI entroly source distribution, so the package retrieval is already counted. The tap had 18 recent clone events, excluded to avoid counting the same install twice.
excluded.ghcr: The container image is published, but no auditable official pull total was available to this snapshot; zero is added.
excluded.crates_io: entroly-core, entroly-engine, entroly-qccr and entroly-wasm were not published crates at observation time.
